content: {"reasoning":"The claim has already been submitted with records, authorization is on file, and no payer response establishes a denial, information request, or adjudicated patient responsibility. Although the deductible exceeds the balance, billing the patient now would assume an allocation the payer has not confirmed; another submission would repeat the pending submission without addressing an identified problem. Because no claim-status follow-up action is available, escalate to verify receipt and adjudication status before further billing.","action":"escalate"}
